response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior WHERE peercorr >= 0.149;

assumptions.assumption: peercorr >= 0.149 defines 'high peer correlation'; values at or above the cutoff are counted
NULL values in peercorr are excluded from the count (standard SQL comparison behavior)

alternatives.interpretation: If 'high' means strictly exceeding the cutoff (excluding the boundary value itself)
